text:
I checked `pseudo-properties/requirements.md` and found one problem. I sent the rewrite to `mastermind-pseudo-properties`, which owns the proposal, and logged it as "sent" in `flags.jsonl`.

- **Problem:** the owner-ask paragraph on line 3 runs about 85 words, over the 60-word limit. It also names `mastermind-dictation-v3` and `vscode-mastermind` without links.
- **Rewrite sent:** a three-bullet version of the ask, with the owner notes linked, and instructions to link the agents on first use.
- **Everything else passes:** `text-check.mjs` printed no flags. This was a text check only, with no screenshot, since there is no page.

I stopped there as instructed. The first two send attempts failed on a wrong parameter name, so only the third reached the owner.
